cases.text: Patient SSN 123-45-6789, DOB 05/14/1972, reachable at jane.doe@example.com or (555) 123-9988, ZIP 90210.

expect.filtered_text: Patient SSN {{{REDACTED-ssn}}}, DOB {{{REDACTED-date}}}, reachable at {{{REDACTED-email-address}}} or {{{REDACTED-phone-number}}}, ZIP {{{REDACTED-zip-code}}}.

rationale: Five PII types in one sentence under one policy. Single-filter cases cannot catch a filter claiming text that belongs to another, which is where implementations most plausibly diverge.
Note the phone number is not read as an SSN and the SSN is not read as a phone number, even though both are digit groups with hyphens.
An IP, a card number and an ISO date together. The card must not be split by the date filter, and the IP must not be read as a version or a date.

cases.text: The EIN is 12-3456789 and the SSN is 123-45-6789.

expect.filtered_text: The EIN is {{{REDACTED-ein}}} and the SSN is {{{REDACTED-ssn}}}.

rationale: EIN and SSN have overlapping shapes, so a document containing both pins which filter claims which.
This is the case that fails first if either pattern is loosened.
An ordinary sentence under a policy with eight filters enabled must produce nothing. Guards against any filter matching prose.
